orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sudhanshu Dhulia,Hon'ble Mr. Justice Alok Kumar Verma
orders.text:
SPA No.425 of 2015
Hon’ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
This case has been heard through video 
conferencing.
Mr. J.C. Pandey, Standing Counsel for the 
State/appellants.
Mr. Tapan Singh, Advocate for the respondent.
This special appeal has been filed by the 
State/appellants against the judgment and order dated 
30.04.2014 passed by a learned Single Judge of this 
Court in Writ Petition (M/S) No. 1301 of 2008.
The appeal is delayed by 444 days, which is 
accompanied by the delay condonation application 
(CLMA No.9715/2015).
It is a matter of land acquisition and 
considering the constrains of the State Government,
and the cause of delay, we hereby condone the delay.
Delay condonation application is allowed (CLMA 
No.9715/2015).
List this case in the week commencing 
05.10.2020.
(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) 28.09.2020
Ankit/
